waves.title: Wave 1 (week 1, free + fast)
waves.note: Crunchbase first, then the free startup directories. All sites each.

waves.title: Wave 2 (weeks 2-3, curated/slow)
waves.note: Curated and editorial targets. Badge-or-paid decision for Fazier before starting.

waves.title: Wave 3 (staggered launches)
waves.note: One Product Hunt launch per site, weeks apart, Tue-Thu. Show HN only with a genuine data/technical hook.

waves.title: Wave 4 (paid, approve budget first)
waves.note: Jasmine, then BOTW, Postmake, Microlaunch only if Waves 1-3 ROI is proven.

waves.title: Wave 5 (outreach, parallel weeks 2-6)
waves.note: Personalized 3-sentence pitch plus one link. No mass templates.

waves.title: Long-term GEO
waves.note: Retry Wikidata quarterly once press/citations exist.

waves.title: Operator company
waves.note: One company citation, not a per-site play.

directories.name: Crunchbase
directories.authority: DR ~91; canonical company entity LLMs consult
directories.why: Highest authority x near-certain acceptance, plus AI-entity value.

directories.name: Launching Next
directories.requirements: No account; editorial review; plain form + math check
directories.why: Free, no account, daily review: fastest real link of the batch.

directories.name: SaaSHub Startup Directory
directories.authority: DR ~72-80 (sources vary); dofollow per public lists
directories.verticals: all (via Startup Directory path, not SaaS)
directories.why: Free dofollow-leaning link on a high-DR domain via startup path.

directories.name: Uneed
directories.why: High-acceptance launch listing with lasting dofollow value.

directories.name: StartupBase
directories.why: Free, founder-fit, trivial OAuth signup.

directories.name: PeerPush
directories.authority: DR ~73; dofollow; indexed; listings expose MCP/API
directories.why: Free dofollow plus the only launch directory that courts AI crawlers.

directories.name: BetaList
directories.why: Most prestigious easy-submit startup listing; curation is the only risk.

directories.name: PitchWall
directories.why: Generous free tier with dofollow + newsletter upside.

directories.name: LinkCentre
directories.requirements: Account; human review before listing goes live
directories.why: Oldest human-reviewed general directory with a real free tier.

directories.name: Curlie
directories.requirements: No account for suggest; volunteer-editor review (slow, weeks/months)
directories.verticals: all (suggest each into its vertical category)
directories.why: Highest-trust free link; slowness is the only cost.

directories.name: Product Hunt
directories.authority: DR ~90+; top launch traffic; listings surface in AI answers
directories.verticals: all (stagger: one launch each, weeks apart)
directories.why: Biggest traffic/brand swing; directories can launch as data products.

directories.name: F6S
directories.why: Free company profile on a long-lived founder network.

directories.name: Wellfound
directories.why: Near-Crunchbase authority for a free company profile.

directories.name: Indie Hackers Products
directories.why: Founder-trust link; milestones double as content.

directories.name: Hacker News Show HN
directories.requirements: Account; Show HN rules (one shot per product; technical angle)
directories.verticals: data-story sites first, then 1-2 others max
directories.why: One good Show HN beats ten small directories.

directories.name: Startup Stash
directories.why: Curated founder directory; confirm cost in form.

directories.name: KillerStartups
directories.why: Editorial feature, not just a listing.

directories.name: Fazier
directories.cost: Free w/ reciprocal homepage badge, or $29/$49/$139 one-time
directories.requirements: Badge embed (free) or checkout; 30-day review on free
directories.why: Strong claimed DR, but free tier costs a reciprocal homepage link.

directories.name: Jasmine Directory
directories.requirements: Payment; editor review; structured-data listing page
directories.why: Best category fit of any paid general directory.

directories.name: Best of the Web
directories.why: Oldest strict-editorial directory; confirm price in form.

directories.name: Postmake
directories.requirements: Checkout or badge embed; manual review
directories.why: Permanent listing, but paid-only-without-badge caps its rank.

directories.name: Wikidata
directories.requirements: Account; notability gate (new sites likely rejected until press/citations exist)
directories.authority: Top-tier entity source for LLMs (Wikipedia sister)
directories.why: Highest GEO leverage per link, gated behind notability; retry quarterly.

directories.name: Blogarama
directories.requirements: Account; site must have a real blog
directories.verticals: only verticals with a genuine blog
directories.why: Free if you blog; skip (do not fake a blog) if you do not.

directories.name: ChamberofCommerce.com
directories.verticals: operator company only (1 listing, not per-site)
directories.why: One honest company citation; not a per-site play.

directories.name: Microlaunch
directories.why: Paid-only with modest traffic; verify ROI first.

directories.name: Seniorly Partners
directories.requirements: Manual partnership outreach (they list communities, not directories)
directories.authority: Leading senior-living marketplace; high vertical trust
directories.why: Best-fit partner target; pitch data/API collaboration.

directories.name: Caring.com Partners
directories.why: Same play as Seniorly; run both in parallel.

directories.name: CHADD
directories.authority: The national ADHD nonprofit; clinical trust
directories.why: A .org resource link here beats any paid directory.

directories.name: NAPIA
directories.requirements: Manual outreach (members-only association; pitch consumer-resource link)
directories.why: Only authoritative body in the vertical.

directories.name: NATP
directories.why: Credible tax-pro audience.

directories.name: Hitched UK
directories.requirements: Manual outreach to content team (directory is vendors-only)
directories.why: Genuine content for their guides.

directories.name: RadiologyInfo.org
directories.why: Hardest pitch, highest clinical trust.
